priorityList: Summon your pet before combat starts.
Use offensive racials, trinkets, and potions when Takedown is ready or its buff is active.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if the target is further than 6 yards away.
Use Kill Command if you have zero stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Use Boomstick if you have at least one stack of Tip of the Spear and Takedown is not ready.
Use Wildfire Bomb if Tip of the Spear is active and you are about to reach maximum bomb charges.
Use Kill Command if Takedown is about to become available to ensure you have Tip of the Spear stacks ready.
Use Takedown if Tip of the Spear is active (or at zero stacks if Twin Fangs is talented).
Use Moonlight Chakram if you have at least one stack of Tip of the Spear.
Use Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or to maintain the Raptor Swipe buff.
Use Kill Command to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks while Takedown is on cooldown.
Use Wildfire Bomb as a filler if Tip of the Spear is not available.
Use Takedown as a final priority if available.
